title: Trader Diary: The RARE 82% Rollercoaster
content:
- 9 AM: Spot Bitcoin steady, I’m sipping coffee.
- 12 PM: RARE spikes 82% and I’m suddenly a ‘crypto guru’ in my mind.
- 1 PM: My margin alert screams louder than my mom’s group chat.
lesson: If a meme‑coin’s price moves faster than your heart rate, it’s time to hit pause and check the stop‑loss.
question: Who else rode the RARE wave and lived to tell the tale? Drop your best panic‑emoji story 👇
